title: The Application of Emotion Valence Ratios in Facial Emotion Recognition for Detecting Depression Among Older Adults in Institutional Settings
summary: Developing evidence-based parameters to enhance the reliability of face emotion recognition (FER) systems in detecting depression among the elderly is essential. This study aims to elucidate the relationship between the ratio of each emotion valence captured by the FER system and heart rate variability (HRV) while participants watch a video in relation to their depression scores. YOLO, an open-source data analysis toolkit, was used to extract three facial emotion valence features (neutral, positive, and negative) and determine the ratio of each emotion valence over time during video viewing. Additionally, HRV was assessed, and the Geriatric Depression Scale was administered to understand the correlation between FER parameters and depression scores.

标题：情绪效价比值在养老机构老年人面部情绪识别抑郁检测中的应用
摘要：开发循证参数以提高面部情绪识别（FER）系统在检测老年人抑郁方面的可靠性至关重要。本研究旨在阐明参与者在观看视频时FER系统捕获的每种情绪效价比值与心率变异性（HRV）之间的关系及其与抑郁得分的关联。研究采用开源数据分析工具包YOLO提取三种面部情绪效价特征（中性、积极和消极），并确定观看视频期间各情绪效价比值随时间的变化。此外，评估HRV并施测老年抑郁量表，以了解FER参数与抑郁得分之间的相关性。
